name: ai-community
description: 用 AI 与智能体作为基础设施层重构兴趣社区体验

scripts.build: pnpm --filter web build && cd server-go && go build -o bin/server ./cmd/server
scripts.lint:go: test -z "$(gofmt -l server-go)" && cd server-go && go vet ./...
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter web typecheck && pnpm --filter shared typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
